_comment: W151 test fixture - expected parse of fidelity_activity_lrcx_s108.csv.
_why: Derived with Russ 2026-08-26 against the live LRCX condor and verified to the cent against the position's stored max_loss. A matcher that reproduces this is a matcher that works: the file carries all five Fidelity action forms, a PARTIAL close (20 -> 7 traded + 13 settled), an assignment, an exercise, and two expiries.
_ignore: The 2026-06-02 open and 2026-06-15 close are a separate LRCX CSP (JUL 17 $300). They must NOT match the condor. That is the trap this fixture exists to catch.

entry_2026_06_29._note: These are the BROKER fills. HELM currently stores 29.47 / 25.20 / 14.81 / 14.30 - synthesised by proportional scaling from the net (open_cmd.py:1975). Confirming should overwrite them with these.

assignment_2026_08_19._note: Run Date 08/20 but 'as of 2026-08-19'. The as-of date is the real one and the parser must prefer it.
